'''Deluge Control''' was a command center constructed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] on the plateau [[Final Rest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. The facility served to control the [[Deluge Device]], a large [[Moisture vaporator|vaporator]]-like machine developed by the CSA during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[Deluge Experiment]], an effort to alter Nyriaan's climate.
